content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Platforms like Teachable and Stripe provide a seamless experience for selling courses, offering integrated payment processing and user-friendly interfaces. However, they come with significant limitations for creators in restricted countries. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, allows creators to build their own digital storefronts at minimal cost, utilizing free tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. This self-sufficiency ensures creators retain complete control over their products and data, a stark contrast to the dependency created by conventional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal often exclude specific countries from their services due to regulatory concerns, limiting payment processing options for creators. For instance, PayPal can freeze accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal, leaving creators in a vulnerable position. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these restrictions. By leveraging technologies like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, creators can operate independently of these platforms, ensuring they are not hindered by geographical limitations and retaining full access to their earnings.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors in choosing a sales platform. Stripe typically charges a percentage of each transaction, which adds up over time, especially for creators with high sales volumes. Additionally, delays in payment processing can disrupt cash flow. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, through solutions like NOWPayments, offers low fees of just 0.5% and near-instant payment confirmations on-chain with popular cryptocurrencies. This approach not only reduces costs but also accelerates payment cycles, allowing creators to reinvest in their businesses more quickly.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees your independence from restrictive payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital assets is a crucial consideration for creators. With platforms like Teachable, users often find themselves subjected to terms that restrict access to their data and products. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides complete ownership post-deployment. After implementing a stack like the Edge Commerce Stack for $197, creators have their own operational systems in place, ensuring automatic delivery of products, full data control, and the ability to scale without any ongoing dependencies or fees.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and constraints. If you are in a country where traditional platforms are unavailable or unreliable, adopting sovereign commerce infrastructure is the optimal solution. The Edge Commerce Stack, for instance, can be deployed in just 48 hours, enabling you to start selling courses without the limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe or PayPal. Evaluate your needs, consider the long-term implications of ownership and control, and make the switch to an architecture that empowers you.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and data with no ongoing dependencies.

This stack allows creators to build a fully operational store tailored to their unique needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective option for processing crypto payments without the burdens of traditional platforms.

No, with sovereign commerce infrastructure, you retain complete ownership of your funds and data. Unlike traditional platforms, there are no account freezes or restrictions that can jeopardize your earnings.
